name: Ergometrine
aliases: ergonovine, Ergonovine, D-lysergic acid-L-propanolamide, ergobasine, Ergobasine, Ergometrina, Ergométrine, Ergometrinum
summary: Ergonovine, also known as ergometrine and lysergic acid propanolamide, is a medication used to cause contractions of the uterus to treat heavy vaginal bleeding after childbirth. It can be used either by mouth, by injection into a muscle, or injection into a vein.
